plan: Given my value of $48, I aim to win the auction by outbidding others while maximizing profit. Assuming others bid close to their values, I will bid slightly below my value to ensure a win and minimize cost. A bid of $47.9 should be competitive, as it is close to my value and likely higher than the third-highest bid, ensuring a profit margin. This strategy aims to balance winning with maximizing profit by paying the least possible.

Given my value of $11, I aim to bid just below my value to ensure potential profit while minimizing loss. Assuming other bids are uniformly distributed, they may average around $24.5. I will bid $10.9 to win only if others bid lower. If I win, I pay the third-highest bid, maximizing profit. If others bid higher, I lose nothing. This strategy balances risk and reward, optimizing long-term profit.

Given my value of $10, I aim to bid strategically to win only if it's profitable. I expect others to bid close to their values, possibly slightly higher to ensure winning. If I bid $10, I risk paying more than my value if the third-highest bid is close to mine. Thus, I will bid slightly lower, around $8, to avoid overpaying while still having a chance to win if others undervalue. This minimizes risk and maximizes potential profit by ensuring I pay less than my value if I win.
